title: Proposal Decline Reason
description: Machine-readable reason a buyer is no longer pursuing a proposal. Sellers use this only for aggregate feedback; buyers MUST NOT disclose competitor identity or confidential terms.

enumDescriptions.price: Price, rate, or cost efficiency did not meet the buyer's requirement.
enumDescriptions.inventory_fit: Inventory, placements, format mix, availability, or forecast did not fit the brief.
enumDescriptions.audience_fit: The proposal did not sufficiently match the required audience or targeting.
enumDescriptions.creative_unsupported: The seller could not support the required creative format, asset, or production workflow.
enumDescriptions.measurement_unsupported: The seller could not support required measurement, reporting, attribution, or verification.
enumDescriptions.policy: The proposal was incompatible with buyer, seller, governance, legal, or brand-suitability policy.
enumDescriptions.timing: The schedule, expiry, approval timing, or delivery window did not fit.
enumDescriptions.budget_changed: The buyer's budget, scope, or campaign plan changed after evaluation.
enumDescriptions.selected_alternative: The buyer selected another approach or supply source.
